svg.title: LLaMAR framework layers: explicit agentic/DAG modes, A2A control, and SAR observation loop
svg.desc: A compact source-grounded layered diagram. Agentic execution runs through CoordinatorAgentExecutor._execute_agentic(), AgentController.submit(), build_router_agent(), and Agent.run(). DAG execution runs through CoordinatorAgentExecutor._execute_dag_loop() and RouterAgent.route_dag() without AgentController.submit(). Worker WebSocket control is limited to register and heartbeat; tasks and cancellation use A2A. SAR action results form an independent SARBarrier.submit_action() and SAREnv.step() to ToolResult/observation and the next WorkerAgent Agent.run() round.
svg.metadata: Source-checked symbols: src/a2a/coordinator/agent_executor.py:266-271,305-450,452-475; src/Agent/controller/controller.py:164-277; src/Agent/router_agent/build.py:119-194; src/Agent/router_agent/agent.py:426-850; src/a2a/coordinator/router.py:390-409,727-755; src/a2a/coordinator/server.py:1429-1510; src/a2a/builtin_tools/cancel_task.py:20-185; src/a2a/worker/coordinator_client.py:30-142; src/a2a/worker/agent_adapter.py:135-260; sar_orch/barrier.py:74-236,382-476; sar_orch/tools/worker/_barrier_helpers.py:21-64; sar_orch/tools/worker/*.py; SAR/env.py. Semantic invariants: (1) agentic path = CoordinatorAgentExecutor._execute_agentic() → AgentController.submit() → build_router_agent() / Agent.run(); DAG path = CoordinatorAgentExecutor._execute_dag_loop() → RouterAgent.route_dag(), with an explicit DAG bypass of AgentController.submit(). (2) Active Worker WebSocket control = register / heartbeat only; WS_CANCEL_TASK is a coordinator-side notification and the Worker receiver is not wired. Task/cancel semantics are represented on A2A. (3) SAR result loop is independent: SARBarrier.submit_action() / SAREnv.step() → ToolResult / observation → WorkerAgent / Agent.run() next round; it is not the Coordinator A2A push feedback lane.

g.text: 源码路径驱动 · Coordinator → A2A → Worker → SAR · 任务、控制、反馈分色
LAYER 1 · Coordinator orchestration / 运行模式分流
LAYER 2 · A2A task / result transport + Coordinator feedback
任务/取消走 A2A；push 只投影到 Coordinator
A2A push callback · Coordinator view only
WebSocket control surface · active Worker control only
LAYER 4 · SAR action bridge + independent observation loop
SAR result does not merge with Coordinator push feedback

g.title: next WorkerAgent / Agent.run() round
g.text: 独立 SAR feedback → next Agent.run()
